newsitem.title: USA: Shoppers Food Warehouse sells $200 mln 144a debt.
newsitem.headline: Shoppers Food Warehouse sells $200 mln 144a debt.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Shoppers Food Warehouse Corp was priced on Monday via sole manager Wasserstein Perella Securities (Grantchester Securities), according to market sources.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to replace an outstanding bridge loan provided by Wasserstein Perella in January, the source said.
Shoppers Food Warehouse, based in Lanham, Maryland, operates 34 warehouse-style supermarkets in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.
